caption: The drawing features a single white or light-colored dress with short sleeves and an empire waist, depicted in the upper left, occupying the majority of the composition. The dress is adorned with intricate lace and embroidery details at the neckline, sleeves, and hem, all rendered in fine lines and delicate shading. To the right of the dress, two rectangular swatches of fabric are illustrated, both horizontally oriented and similarly decorated with embroidery and lacework in bands. The background is a plain, beige or off-white color, with no additional objects or decorations. The overall use of color is minimal, primarily relying on soft gray pencil or ink lines to suggest texture, pattern, and shadow.
title: Infant's Baptismal Dress
